title: Six Crossroads teams compete in high-level preseason volleyball tournament - NewsBreak
text: We look at six Crossroads teams competing in second preseason volleyball tournament in Victoria VICTORIA, Texas- Earlier today, the Crossroads Sports Center in Victoria hosted its second preseason tournament. Eight playoff teams from last season competed, with six of them coming from the Crossroads area. Those six teams were Edna, Industrial, Goliad, Victoria St. Joseph, El Campo, and Victoria West. The two non-Crossroads teams were the 5A Division I champions Flour Bluff and Beeville. At the end of the tournament, Goliad defeated Flour Bluff in the championship game, and Victoria St. Joseph beat Victoria West in the third-place game. Goliad junior volleyball player Addison Yendrey described how this tournament will help the team heading into the regular season. "We're getting to know each other, and it's a new team. We're trying to stay in sync with each other more this season to help us as a whole," Yendrey said. Another Goliad standout, Isabel Sanchez, hopes this team can avenge last season's championship loss to Bushland. "This is mostly the same team. We lost only two seniors from last year. We hope this experience and us connecting earlier can help us win the championship this season," Sanchez said. Over at Victoria West, the team went 41-6 and was undefeated in district play before losing in the regional semifinals. Returner Kristin Kohutek appreciates the vocal communication the team is showing during these preseason tournaments. "We're talking a lot more and working more as a team. We did lose a couple of key players from last season, but I think we can come back and go farther this year if we stay the course," Kohutek said. Overall, these eight playoff teams hope to keep improving heading into regular season play, which starts August 11th. ​COPYRIGHT 2025 BY CROSSROADS TODAY. ALL RIGHTS RESERVED.
